content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Accessibility Initiative: Regional Fintech Rollout Planning
agenda_items: Review of current accessibility audit findings for regional platforms
Stakeholder alignment on communication strategy for accessibility updates
Discussion on integration of WCAG 2.2 AA standards into development lifecycle
Resource allocation and budget considerations for compliance initiatives
key_decisions: Prioritize screen reader compatibility and keyboard navigation enhancements for the next two product cycles.
Adopt a phased approach for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance, starting with critical user journeys.
Allocate a specific budget increment for accessibility training for development teams over the next six months.
